d: CoorB is looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build and deploy AI solutions for digital banking. You will build production-grade LLM applications, including retrieval-augmented systems, knowledge graphs and fine-tuned models, that deliver measurable business value to our banking clients across the GCC.
Design and build RAG pipelines: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search and re-ranking.
Build and maintain knowledge bases and knowledge graphs (for example Neo4j, or GraphRAG approaches).
Fine-tune LLMs (LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT) on domain-specific data, and evaluate them against base models.
Develop agentic AI workflows, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration and memory.
Set up LLM evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, hallucination rate, latency and cost.
Deploy and operate models in production ( LLMOps/MLOps ), including monitoring, versioning and CI/CD.
Apply security, data privacy and responsible AI practices suited to regulated banking environments.
Work with architects, developers and client stakeholders to turn business needs into AI solutions.
All of the following are required
5–7 years in software, ML or AI engineering, with at least 2 years building LLM-based applications.
Strong Python; hands-on with LangChain, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks.
Proven experience building RAG systems in production.
Hands-on with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Azure AI Search or similar).
Experience with knowledge graphs and graph databases.
Proven experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Qwen or similar) using Hugging Face tooling.
Experience with commercial LLM APIs (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini).
Experience building agentic AI and multi-agent solutions, including MCP (Model Context Protocol).
On premises, Cloud experience on Azure, AWS or GCP , plus Docker and Kubernetes.
Solid grasp of prompt engineering, embeddings and LLM evaluation methods.
Arabic NLP or multilingual model experience.
Experience in banking, fintech or other regulated industries.
Familiarity with SAMA or other GCC regulatory and data-residency requirements.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. The successful candidates will focus on our Ubuntu product portfolio, which is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer offering, Ubuntu Core for IoT, provides state-of-the-art security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment, serving global brands in consumer, industrial electronics, automotive, and robotics. We are continually enhancing this portfolio with features like real-time Linux capability and pursuing various certifications, representing Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint. We seek technically skilled professionals familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS.

This is a high-energy role focused on prospecting sales and strategic account development, demanding ambition and focus. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.
Location: We are growing our sales reach with remote roles in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas; and office based roles in Taipei, Taiwan.
Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
Closing contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
Managing customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
Working with Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management
q: Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
x: We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

q: What It Takes to Make the Stay

r: Deliver a warm welcome: Greet guests upon arrival and complete the check-in process, including verifying details, assigning rooms, issuing keys, and providing welcome materials or bell service assistance

d: Nass MEP is looking for an experienced MEP Operations Manager to lead and coordinate the successful delivery of multiple mechanical, electrical, and plumbing projects across Bahrain, from preconstruction and planning through execution, testing, commissioning, and final handover.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual, technical, quality, and regulatory requirements. This role requires strong leadership, commercial awareness, technical knowledge, project management expertise, and the ability to effectively coordinate clients, main contractors, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering .
Minimum 15+ years of progressive experience in MEP project execution, construction, or related project operations.
Proven experience managing multiple MEP projects from planning and execution through testing, commissioning, and final handover.
Previous experience working in the GCC region , preferably with strong knowledge of the Bahrain construction environment.
Strong knowledge of MEP systems, project planning, budgeting, resource management, procurement, cost control, and project execution.
Strong understanding of MEP design standards, construction practices, testing and commissioning requirements, and applicable local regulations.
Demonstrated experience managing subcontractors, suppliers, and multidisciplinary engineering and site teams.
Strong understanding of quality, health, safety, and environmental requirements.
Proven ability to manage client, main contractor, consultant, subcontractor, and supplier relationships.
Excellent communication, coordination, leadership, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while delivering against challenging schedules, budgets, and contractual requirements.
Strong reporting, commercial awareness, and decision-making capabilities.
PMP certification or relevant professional engineering license is an advantage.
r: Oversee the full lifecycle of multiple MEP projects, ensuring compliance with approved schedules, specifications, budgets, contractual requirements, and quality standards.
Lead coordination with clients, main contractors, consultants, and other key stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.
Prepare and manage detailed project plans, scopes of work, timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and project schedules.
Develop and manage project budgets, monitor expenditures, and implement effective cost-control measures to support profitable project delivery.
Support preconstruction and work-winning activities, including project inputs, estimates, planning assumptions, technical coordination, and project execution strategies.
Coordinate the procurement of MEP materials, equipment, and services in collaboration with the Supply Chain and Procurement teams.
Plan and optimize the allocation and utilization of manpower, materials, plant, machinery, equipment, and other project resources.
Supervise Project Managers, engineers, site teams, and cross-disciplinary leads to ensure effective and timely project execution.
Manage and coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, and third-party vendors to ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.
Review technical specifications, shop drawings, BOQs, equipment data sheets, method statements, material submissions, and other MEP-related documentation.
Oversee MEP testing, commissioning, documentation, close-out activities, and final project handover.
Monitor project progress and identify potential delays, cost overruns, resource constraints, technical issues, and operational risks, ensuring timely corrective action.
Prepare and submit regular project progress, cost, performance, and management reports, highlighting key risks, delays, corrective actions, and decisions required.
Ensure compliance with applicable Bahraini regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, technical standards, quality requirements, and HSSE procedures .
Develop and implement effective quality-control measures to ensure MEP works meet approved specifications and applicable standards.
Maintain effective communication and coordination with internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor the effective utilization of plant, machinery, manpower, materials, and subcontractor resources and prevent unnecessary expenditure or misuse.
Support the timely resolution of technical, commercial, procurement, and operational issues affecting project delivery.
Ensure projects are completed within agreed timelines, approved budgets, and required contractual and regulatory standards.
Perform other duties and assignments as directed by the MEP Division Manager in line with business requirements.

d: Designfit is a design and interior fit-out company coordinating design, procurement, and project delivery for commercial spaces. Working in the construction sector, the company delivers commercial interiors through close collaboration across design, supply, and site execution teams.

This Project Manager role is central to the successful delivery of interior fit-out projects, bringing structure, oversight, and momentum across the full project lifecycle. You will work closely with clients and project stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with project goals, quality expectations, timelines, and budgets.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field.
A Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field is considered an advantage.
PMP, LEED, or NEBOSH certification is considered an advantage.
10–15 years of relevant interior fit-out experience, including at least three years in project management overseeing complete project lifecycles.
Experience delivering high-end commercial, retail, food and beverage, hospitality, or corporate office projects on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional project teams, coordinate with clients, consultants, and subcontractors, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Local authority regulations and approval processes, including DM, DCD, and Trakhees
Experience working on projects in the UAE and familiarity with regional construction practices are highly preferred.
r: Lead and manage all phases of the interior fit-out project lifecycle, including design coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
Develop detailed project programs and deliver milestones on schedule and within budget.
Coordinate clients, consultants, designers, suppliers, and subcontractors around project goals.
Review drawings, specifications, material submittals, and method statements.
Conduct site inspections to monitor progress, quality, and health and safety compliance.
Manage procurement schedules and delivery of long-lead items.
Prepare project reports, meeting minutes, and progress documentation.
Track cost control, change orders, cash flow forecasts, and other project financials.
Lead snagging and handover with relevant stakeholders.
Undertake other duties assigned by management in line with organizational needs.

d: Sales Executive AquaChem Trading Co W.I.I. (Bahrain) Manama, Bahrain 10/30/26 Sales & Business Development

Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide. Discover us at gradiant.com.
Sales Engineer / Technical Consultant is responsible for driving sales growth while providing comprehensive technical support and services to both new and existing clients.

Role involves building and maintaining strong client relationships, managing the entire sales cycle from lead generation to order closure, and offering expert technical guidance during and after project implementation.

Key responsibilities also include active participation in sales processes, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction through quality service and effective technical solutions. The overall objective is to achieve consistent and sustainable growth within the region.
q: Technical Expertise: Strong command of water treatment processes, specialty chemicals, and system performance optimization across industries.
Analytical and Problem-Solving: Skilled in conducting system assessments, performance diagnostics, and root cause analysis to deliver effective and sustainable treatment solutions.
Commercial Acumen: Deep understanding of costing, proposal development, and tender management, ensuring technically sound and competitive submissions.
Client Relationship Management: Experienced in developing long-term partnerships through consistent engagement, value addition, and high-level communication with clients and stakeholders.

Adaptability and Initiative: Comfortable operating in dynamic environments, taking ownership of projects from concept to completion, and continually improving processes to align with organizational goals.
Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills and networking abilities to foster robust relationships with customers
Must be able to achieve sales targets and possess strong networking skills within the water treatment industry.
5+ years of experience in sales or technical consultant in a water treatment industry

Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.
r: Develop and implement effective sales strategies and inventive sales campaigns tailored to target industries, ensuring alignment with company goals and market opportunities.
Identify and pursue new business opportunities through thorough outreach efforts, including networking with clients, consultants, contractors, and key industry stakeholders.
Generate inquiries and leads for specialty water treatment chemicals across all system types, across multiple industries including refining/process applications.
Provide reports on potential sales, market information, client activities, and lead status to management.
Prepare, submit technical and commercial tenders for water treatment chemical programs and associated services across multiple industries, including oil & gas, power, and infrastructure.
Coordinate closely with procurement, finance, and management teams to gather necessary data for costing, approvals, and risk assessments.
Prepare comprehensive proposals incorporating technical methodologies, system understanding, dosage and calculation sheets, compliance matrices, and commercial justifications.
Engage in technical clarifications, negotiations, and post-tender follow-ups.
Manage client accounts that require enhanced attention, customized interactions, and value-driven service delivery beyond standard account handling.
Act as a ‘technical consultant on retainer’ for strategic clients, offering ongoing guidance on system optimization, troubleshooting, and chemical program improvement.
Continuously enhance the value proposition for key accounts by introducing new solutions, technologies, and best practices that improve operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
Provide expertise on chemical applications and dosage calculations, guiding clients in selecting the most suitable solutions for their specific needs.
Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure seamless project execution, including delivery commitments related to materials and services.
Respond promptly and professionally to all inquiries, service requests, and complaints, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
Provide after-sales service by conducting site visits, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring optimal product performance.
Provide regular updates to clients through monthly reports, lab reports, water testing reports, and yearly performance evaluations.
Deep understanding of ongoing integration activities and internal workflows to ensure alignment across departments and smooth adoption of new procedures.
Collaborate to streamline practices and enhance overall efficiency.
